_comment: E5: every test file that is skipped or marked e2e/slow, the layer it belongs to and when it actually runs. scripts/ci/check_test_layers.py fails CI when a skipped test is missing here. trigger: ci (runs on every PR), manual (command below), pending (no run time yet: needs a decision).

tests/integration/analysis/test_sql_exec.how: start the demo business databases (docker compose up -d demo_business_acme demo_business_beta) and set ACME_DEMO_DATABASE_PASSWORD; A11b ran it in the one-off container agent-sqltest

tests/integration/conversations/test_con.how: pytest -m e2e with the Compose stack running (capacity-signal service)

tests/integration/documents/test_documen.how: pytest -m slow tests/integration/documents/test_document_tasks.py in the evaluation image (models cached)

tests/integration/input_artifacts/test_l.how: RUN_LOCAL_OBJECT_STORAGE_E2E=1 pytest -m e2e with LocalStack up

tests/integration/workflow/test_celery_e.how: docker compose --profile test up -d worker-test; RUN_REAL_CELERY_E2E=1 pytest -m e2e

tests/unit/evaluation/test_full_corpus_r.how: RUN_FULL_CORPUS_RAG_EVAL=1 in the evaluation container; the CI behavior gate runs the same retrieval strategies on every PR

tests/unit/analysis/test_sql_executor.py.how: two tests are skipped unconditionally: they query the default business database through execute_readonly_sql, a path A11b closed. Waiting for a decision: delete them or rewrite against a registered demo connection.
